agentCoreGateways.name: TravelDeskGateway
agentCoreGateways.description: Duffel flight tools for the Travel Desk (reads) and Flight Ops (writes), Cedar enforced

toolDefinitions.name: search_flights
toolDefinitions.description: Search Duffel Airways offers; returns the 3 cheapest, normalized.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip, empty for one way

toolDefinitions.name: get_order
toolDefinitions.description: One order of the traveler, normalized.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: list_orders
toolDefinitions.description: All orders of the traveler, normalized.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: seat_map
toolDefinitions.description: Available seats with prices for an offer.

toolDefinitions.name: change_options
toolDefinitions.description: Priced options to move one slice of an order to a new date. Read only.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: bag_options
toolDefinitions.description: Extra baggage that can be added to an order. Read only.

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

toolDefinitions.name: change_order
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. Without quote_id: quote moving the order to a change offer. With quote_id: confirm that quote.

quote_id.description: order change id returned by the quote call; empty to quote

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

toolDefinitions.name: cancel_order
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. Without quote_id: refund quote. With quote_id: confirm that cancellation.

quote_id.description: cancellation id returned by the quote call; empty to quote

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

toolDefinitions.name: add_bag
toolDefinitions.description: WRITE. confirm=false: price quote for adding a bag service. confirm=true: add it and pay.

confirm.description: false to quote, true to execute

actor_id.description: Verified traveler id, set by the agent runtime from the session, never by the model

guest_verified.description: True when the caller passed identity verification this session (Cedar requires it for writes)

writes
